acl-live.note: acllive.com has no single infinite-scroll listing; read via firecrawl_map (site URL enumeration) plus direct month-filtered pages (October and November 2026 fully re-verified by direct fetch). Two rooms share the calendar: ACL Live at The Moody Theater and ACL Live at 3TEN, plus Austin PBS Tapings. Several 'unconfirmed' source items turned out to be real support acts billed under a different headliner's title on the venue's own listing (e.g. Barrington Levy under 'Shyne', August Burns Red under 'Underoath') -- these count as gt-miss. The Sep 24 2026 Alison Krauss & Union Station / Theo Lawrence show has its own acllive.com URL but the page itself reads 'CANCELLED. Date. TBD.' as of this read.

brushy.note: One scroll/listing page returned 77 dated events, Sep 3 2026 through Feb 6 2027 (order is not strictly chronological -- Aug/early-Sep 2026 rows sit after the Oct-Dec block, likely a template quirk, but all rows were captured). Brushy Street Commons is the same room/site as the old 'The Parish' (214 E 6th) per the task brief and confirmed by outside sources still calling it 'Parish'. Several source items that don't appear as their own listing turned out to be real support acts folded into a headliner's title already on the calendar (CorMae under 'Official 2026 ACL Nights: Hunx and His Punx', Crayon under 'bunii: BUNIIVERSITY TOUR', Drunk Uncle under 'No One Productions: Ben Quad / Drunk Uncle') -- gt-miss. A cluster of other items (Grace Enger, El Ten Eleven, So This Is Suffering, Creek) are real, independently ticketed Brushy Street shows that simply are not on the venue's own website at all as read -- real-offcalendar. Two items (Punchline at the Pole, Greg Fitzsimmons) are stand-up comedy, not music.

concourse.note: The homepage/calendar 'UPCOMING EVENTS' widget only renders through Oct 31, 2026 (a 'LOAD MORE EVENTS' button did not expand via scroll or a scripted click in this read); later shows were confirmed instead via the venue's own genre tag pages (concourseproject.com/tag/bass, /tag/house, /tag/house-music), which surfaced Nov 27 (Hot Since 82 + Avision), Dec 3 (Franky Rizardo) and Dec 19 (INZO) directly from concourseproject.com's own copy. The venue's homepage explicitly bills itself as 'THE HOME OF SEISMIC DANCE EVENT & REALMUSIC EVENTS' -- Seismic Dance Event 9.0 (Nov 13-15, 2026) is independently confirmed as real via its own official site (seismicdanceevent.com), Ticketmaster and Eventim, all agreeing on venue and dates, even though this read could not scroll concourseproject.com's own listing far enough to see the Nov 13-15 entries directly.

vulcan.calendarUrl: https://www.vulcanatx.com/ (official site found via search; task brief's placeholder URL did not resolve to a real domain)
vulcan.note: vulcanatx.com is a small single-page site (no /events or /calendar subpage -- confirmed via site map) whose homepage widget listed only 13 dated rows, Sep 29 through Nov 24, 2026, and it is dominated by the venue's weekly 'Kill Tony Regulars' comedy night plus a couple of comedy specials and exactly one dance-music listing ('Wobble Wednesdays - Plastician,' Oct 7). This official site is demonstrably incomplete for dance/rave programming: cross-checked against a third-party ticketing aggregator's own Vulcan Gas Company venue page (events.musicofourdesire.com/venue/vulcan-gas-company, 'Mood'), which lists 9 additional real, ticketed dance events at this venue that vulcanatx.com's homepage does not show at all (Next Level KPop Rave, GRIMM HALLOWEEN RAVE, a Kpop Club Night, SHOCK VALUE: Tisoki, Capochino, R&BASS TOUR, HEYZ, MitiS, INFEKT). Treating vulcanatx.com's own page as the calendar of record per the task's method, but flagging that it under-represents this venue more than any other checked.
